projects.name: YouLearn
projects.summary: YouLearn delivers learning experiences for users to get to grips with using online services and mobile apps.
projects.description: YouLearn is one of my favourite ongoing projects to date. The goal is to deliver learning experiences for users to get to grips with using online services and mobile apps. YouLearn places the users in guided sandbox environments where they can learn through realistic scenarios and experiences. YouLearn also provides teachers with classroom management abilities, ease of access features for their learners, and performance analysis tools.
